objectives.description: Decide lint host: extend lint-postflight-boundary.sh or add a new sibling script
objectives.note: Confirmed lint-postflight-boundary.sh only scans SKILL.md under .claude/skills and .claude/extensions (deployed tree) and has no context/patterns/*.md scan surface; its own verify-deploy.sh wiring comment explains it audits deployed content by design. Our check needs to scan agent-system/extensions/*/skills/*/SKILL.md AND agent-system/extensions/*/context/patterns/* (source-store paths, matching the plan's own task wording), so a new sibling script following lint-agent-contracts.sh's source-store-invocation convention was the better fit.

objectives.description: Register both new files in core manifest.json provides.scripts
objectives.note: Necessary corollary of adding new source-store files: deploy-headless.sh only copies files declared in provides.scripts.
